html.content:
Recommended

Bulletscore: 1.0

Bullet chart — performance vs target reference line.

Clinical use: Endpoint vs pre-specified threshold

  • cat + 2 numeric (value + target)
  • 3+ numeric — actual/target/range bullet pattern

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='bullet chart of <metric> vs target by <factor>'

Alternatives

Ribbonscore: 1.0

Ribbon chart — area between two lines showing range over time.

Clinical use: Mean ± SD lab value band over visits

  • numeric start/end ranges per group

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ribbon chart of <lower> to <upper> over <time>'

DotLinescore: 1.0

Forest-plot style: horizontal CI lines with central estimate dot.

Clinical use: Hazard ratios, odds ratios, risk differences

  • cat + numeric — possible forest plot
  • estimate + CI bounds pattern

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='forest plot of <estimate> with CI by <factor>'

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Scatter3Dscore: 0.85

3D scatter for three continuous dimensions.

Clinical use: Multivariate exploratory analysis

  • 3 numeric → x/y/z scatter
  • colour by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='3D scatter of <num1> vs <num2> vs <num3>'
